description: Pin any node to a DesignEpoch (AT_EPOCH) — e.g. a Release to its release_cut epoch, so the release and the design state it was cut from are joined on axis Z. Generic: AT_EPOCH is declared from any type.

node_id.description: The node being pinned; its type is `node_type`.

node_type.description:
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

name: pin_at_epoch
